newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: U.S. vice president flies in for security summit.
newsitem.headline: U.S. vice president flies in for security summit.

text.p: U.S. Vice President Al Gore arrived in Lisbon on Monday to attend the two-day summit of the 54-nation Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe.
Gore, who was due to spend just seven hours in the Portuguese capital, has a whirlwind diplomatic programme.

In addition to addressing the summit, he was to hold meetings with a number of world leaders including Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin, German Chancellor Helmut Kohl, French President Jacques Chirac and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
